::: {#exr-noise-augment}

#### Training on noisy digits

Suppose `fit()` is given `transform=add_noise`,
so that it trains on new noisy copies of the training images at every [epoch](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch).
Is the lowest validation loss of `make_net()` then lower than without noise?

:::
